replay.detail: No new projection invalidation or startup replay trigger in the merged person answers to spontaneous-work asks change.

schema.detail: No database table, index, trigger or migration change in person answers to spontaneous-work asks; SQLite user_version is unchanged.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digest/drop policy are unchanged; this change adds no sealing coordination requirement.

compatibility.detail: A person can answer a structured ask created from spontaneous work without supplying evidence. Closing a handed-off spontaneous work step still requires evidence. Existing pending asks can be answered normally; they need no recreation.

downtime.detail: No additional upgrade service stop or measured outage introduced by person answers to spontaneous-work asks; the standard daemon/client restart procedure still applies.

manual.detail: No data repair or configuration conversion required for existing installations by person answers to spontaneous-work asks.

recovery.detail: No additional recovery procedure introduced by this change. Preserve graph state, keys and configuration and follow the standard roll-forward guidance; this note does not qualify binary-only downgrade of the whole release.
